CONSUL GENERAL FOR NORWAY,
IN TEMPORARY CHARGE OF THE CONSULAR
INTERESTS OF THE U.S.S.R.
IN SHANGHAI

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. DIVISION
No. S. B. D. 9883
Shanghai, March 20, 1940.
Date
URGENT.

Sir,

With reference to my letter of yesterday, concerning
the disappeared Soviet citizen, Miss Tivtcheva, I have the
honour to inform you that this girl has been found by the
Police of the French Concession: your valuable assistance
in this matter is therefore now unnecessary.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔此处为手写签名〕

CONSUL GENERAL FOR NORWAY,
IN TEMPORARY CHARGE OF THE CONSULAR
INTERESTS OF THE U.S.S.R.
IN SHANGHAI

（批：1 D.C. (Sp Br) R.W.H. 20/3）
（批：2 P A Ack）

Major K. M. Bourne, M.C.,
Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai.

（印：SHANGHAI COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 20 MAR. 1940）
（批：FILE 20 1/3）

CONSUL GENERAL FOR NORWAY,
IN TEMPORARY CHARGE OF THE CONSULAR
INTERESTS OF THE U.S.S.R.
IN SHANGHAI

Shanghai, March 19, 1940.

URGENT.

Sir and dear Colleague,

I have the honour to ask for your kind assistance in
the following matter:

It has been brought to my knowledge that Miss Galina
Tivtcheva, an under age Soviet citizen, (about 17 years old)
residing with her parents, Mr. and Mrs. Tivtchev, at 455/17 Rue
Lafayette (Park Apartment) left her home at about 10 a.m. on
Monday March 18, and has later not returned to same.

Miss Tivtcheva was working as a teacher at the Peter
Pan School. (a private British organization at 133, Route de
Boissezon, French Concession); she has been seen several times
lately with a certain Charles James of the E-company 2nd Bat.
U.S.Marine Corps, who might be able to give some information about
her; the last time she is known to have been seen with him was on
Sunday, March 17th. As the parents of Miss Tivtcheva were on the
point of leaving Shanghai for the U.S.S.R. and had already booked
passage for the whole family, the disappearance of the girl as
well as her future fate constitute a matter of grave concern to
them they have now applied to this Consulate General for assistance
to locate her. As Miss Tivtcheva is young and inexperienced, it
is of the greatest importance to find her as soon as possible. I
have therefore the honour to ask you to be kind enough to request
the Police of the French Concession to undertake an immediate
search for her and let me know the result.

I enclose a photograph of Miss Tivtcheva.

I am sending copy of this letter to the Police of the
S.M.C., asking them whether they could assist in locating Miss
Tivtcheva.

Thanking you for your valuable co-operation in this
matter,

I have the honour to be,
Sir and dear Colleague,
Your obedient servant,

(p.) T. Knudtzon,

CONSUL GENERAL FOR NORWAY,
IN TEMPORARY CHARGE OF THE CONSULAR
INTERESTS OF THE U.S.S.R.
IN SHANGHAI

M. Baudet, Esquire,
Consul General for France,
SHANGHAI.

挪威驻上海总领事馆，
暂代苏联在沪领事利益

上海，1940年3月19日。

急件。

先生暨亲爱的同僚：

谨就以下事项请求阁下的善意协助：

据我方获悉，未成年苏联公民加林娜·蒂夫切娃（Galina Tivtcheva）小姐（约17岁），与其父母蒂夫切夫（Tivtchev）夫妇居住于拉斐特路（Rue Lafayette）455/17号（公园公寓），于3月18日（星期一）上午10时左右离家，此后未归。

蒂夫切娃小姐曾在彼得潘学校（Peter Pan School）担任教师（该校为位于法租界蒲石路133号的英国私人机构）；近期有人数次看见她与美军陆战队第二营E连的查尔斯·詹姆斯（Charles James）在一起，此人或许能提供有关她的一些信息；已知最后一次有人看见她与他在一起是在3月17日（星期日）。由于蒂夫切娃小姐的父母正欲离开上海前往苏联，且已为全家预订了船票，女孩的失踪及其未来命运令他们深感忧虑，故现已向本总领事馆申请协助寻找其下落。鉴于蒂夫切娃小姐年轻且缺乏经验，尽快找到她至关重要。因此，谨请阁下惠予要求法租界警方立即展开搜寻，并将结果告知我方。

随函附上蒂夫切娃小姐照片一张。

另将此信副本致送上海公共租界工部局警务处，询问其能否协助寻找蒂夫切娃小姐。

感谢阁下在此事上的宝贵合作，

谨此致意，
先生暨亲爱的同僚，
您顺从的仆人，

（代签）T. 克努森（T. Knudtzon），

挪威驻上海总领事馆，
暂代苏联在沪领事利益

M. 博代（Baudet）先生，
法国总领事，
上海。
